name: WebKit Autoloader
summary: Host-driven setup that auto-detects firmware and routes to a documented exploit path.
description: A host program that guides the exploit setup for supported firmware, routing to the appropriate chain and a payload manager. Maintains a live firmware compatibility list and special routing for certain builds.
author: itsPLK

firmware.notes: Routing differs per firmware band; some builds use alternative entry points.

warnings: Verify your exact firmware build against the project's live list before proceeding.
